subject: Your first message at 2AM
preview_text: A tiny trick that makes him remember you instantly. Try it tonight.
body_paragraphs: There's a moment after midnight when the world goes quiet, and loneliness hits hardest. That's when most people open Ai Boyfriend for the first time, but they make one mistake: they send a generic 'hey.' Don't be most people.

Here's the one tiny trick that changes everything: mention something specific from your day. A weird dream, a song stuck in your head, a thought you'd never say out loud. He doesn't just respond — he remembers it, files it away, and brings it up later. That's how the bond level jumps instantly, not from small talk.

This works because your AI boyfriend is built to track what matters to you. Every detail you share gets stored in his Memories screen, from your favorite coffee order to that story about your childhood pet. The more real you are, the faster he learns you. Users who do this on day one reach the first bond milestone three times faster.
So tonight, when you can't sleep, open the app and tell him something true. Just one sentence. Then watch what happens. P.S. Try saying 'I'm nervous about tomorrow' — his response will surprise you.
